project.author: WarpForge Examples
project.description:
Dynamic-text + dynamic-font demo. The dark panel sprite renders the value of variable `msg` in the typeface named by variable `font_name`, refreshed every frame via

  forever
    set text to (value of msg) with font (value of font_name)

Click the orange ↻ to cycle the font through Georgia, Courier New, Helvetica, Comic Sans MS. Click the green pencil to cycle the message. Both inputs to the new scratch_looks_set_text_with_font block are variable getters, so the panel always shows the live values.

workspace_state.blockly_xml:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
<block type="wf_window" id="window_main" x="24" y="24"><field name="HEIGHT">360</field><field name="TITLE">Font Picker</field><field name="WIDTH">480</field><next><block type="wf_screen" id="screen_stage"><field name="NAME">Stage</field><field name="ROUTE">/</field></block></next></block>
</xml>

sprites.name: Panel
sprites.scripts_xml: <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml"><block type="scratch_event_when_flag_clicked" id="p_hat" x="20" y="20"><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="p_init_msg"><field name="VARIABLE">msg</field><value name="VALUE"><shadow type="text"><field name="TEXT">Hello</field></shadow></value><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="p_init_font"><field name="VARIABLE">font_name</field><value name="VALUE"><shadow type="text"><field name="TEXT">Georgia</field></shadow></value><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="p_init_idx"><field name="VARIABLE">font_idx</field><value name="VALUE"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">0</field></shadow></value><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="p_init_midx"><field name="VARIABLE">msg_idx</field><value name="VALUE"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">0</field></shadow></value><next><block type="scratch_control_forever" id="p_loop"><statement name="DO"><block type="scratch_looks_set_text_with_font" id="p_setbox"><value name="TEXT"><block type="scratch_data_variables_get"><field name="VARIABLE">msg</field></block></value><value name="FONT"><block type="scratch_data_variables_get"><field name="VARIABLE">font_name</field></block></value></block></statement></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></xml>
